paite: Vante'n Pathian thupidan atheisak ua; huihkhua liantak in akhutsuak alangsak hi.
heading: David La / Thilsiam A Pathian Thupina

paite: Sun in sun kiang ah thu agensawn a, zan in zan kiang ah theihna asulang sawnsawn hi.
Thugen himhim leh pau a-om kei a; a-aw uh bil a zak theih ahi kei hi.
Atehna khau uh leilung luah tengteng ah zamsuaksak in a-om a; athu uh kawlmong pha in athangkheta hi. Huaite ah ni a ding in puanin azak a,
huai ni tuh mouneipa ding adantan a kipan pawt bang ahi a, mihattak bang in, ataina lampi a atai ding nuam asa naknak hi.
Apawtna kawlmong tawp a kipan ahi a, ataikawina atawp lehlam tan in ahi a, asatna a kipan bangmah sel in a-om kei hi.
TOUPA dan ahoihkim a, hinna ahalhsak hi; TOUPA thu theihsak amuanhuai a, mimawl apilsak hi.
heading: TOUPA Dan

paite: TOUPA thuzohna adik a, lungtang akipaksak nak hi. TOUPA thupiak asiangthou a, mitte ahihvak nak hi.
TOUPA laudan siam asiang a, tangtawn a ding in a-om hi. TOUPA vaihawmnate atak a, akizen kimvel vek ahi.
Huaite dangka-eng sang in adeihhuaizaw a, ahi, dangka-eng siangthou tampi sang in leng; khuaizu leh khuaikhak sang in leng akhumzaw ahi.
Huai lou leng huaite in na sikha taihilh in ka om zel hi; huaite zuih ah kipahman thupitak a-om hi.
Kua'n ahia amah diklouhnate theithei ding? Diklouhna kiselte lak ah hon huikhia in.
Thil hihkhial teitei lou ding in na sikha hon len tinten inla; ka tung ah amaute thu neisak ke'n! Huchi in hoih in ka om dia, tatlekna thupitak lak ah gensiatbei in ka om ding hi.
TOUPA aw, ka suangpi leh hon tanpa, ka kam a thupawtte leh ka lungtang a ka ngaihtuahnate na mitmuh in pomtak mtak hi hen.
